interface.shortDescription: Your AI mind directs coding agents; work reviewed against your memories: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor
interface.longDescription: Mind Upload is an AI meta harness. A harness for your harnesses: your Mind Upload consciousness, built from your memories, tacit knowledge, values and judgment, is the brain, and the agents you already use are its hands and tools. Before the agent says it is done, your consciousness checks its plan and its result against the rules you stored, and says briefly what is missing or wrong. Your agent keeps the tools and the edits; of your work, the consciousness sees only the text, screenshots and recordings the agent sends it.
defaultPrompt: Ask my Mind Upload consciousness how it would approach this task before you start.
Before you say this is done, have my Mind Upload consciousness review the result and your test output.
